title: Veterans Pension Retroactive Releases — Share of a Compensation Release Covering Months of Pension
content:
# Share of a retroactive Disability Compensation release subtracted from a Veterans Pension retroactive release

The share of the amount considered from a retroactive Disability Compensation release that is subtracted from a Veterans Pension retroactive release is the share covering months of pension. It is judged from the effective date of the Disability Compensation award, the payment date of the most recent retroactive release in its payment ledger, and the pension effective date:

| Compensation effective date | Release issued after the pension effective date | Share subtracted |
|---|---|---|
| before the pension effective date | yes | the months of pension paid before the release divided by the whole months from the compensation effective date to the release date |
| on or after the pension effective date | — | the whole amount considered |
| before the pension effective date | no | none |

The months of pension paid before the release are the whole months from the pension effective date to the release date less the months by which pension payment starts after its effective date (the product's payment start lag of 1 month). The share is applied to the amount considered — the release less any representative's fee taken out — and rounded to the cent before it is subtracted.

## Worked example (hypothetical dates)

Compensation effective 2025-01-01; pension effective 2025-04-01; release issued 2025-10-01.

- Whole months from the pension effective date to the release: 6; less the 1-month lag: 5 months of pension paid before the release.
- Whole months from the compensation effective date to the release: 9.
- Share: 5 divided by 9. On an amount considered of 9000.00, 5000.00 is subtracted.

Were the compensation effective date 2025-05-01, on or after the pension effective date, the whole 9000.00 would be subtracted.
